newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ alters job ad model to derive jobs growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ alters job ad model to derive jobs growth.

text.p: The Australian and New Zealand Banking Group said on Monday it had modified the procedure used to derive short-term projections of employment growth from its monthly jobs advertisement series.
The modification follows a critique published by the Commonwealth Treasury earlier this year, the bank said.
Previously the bank had used a simple rule linking the annual growth rate of employment to the annual growth rate of job advertisements, lagged by six months.
ANZ's new procedure derives forecasts of employment growth from the quarterly growth in job ads and, as suggested by Treasury, changes in unemployment.

In this "model", job ads leads unemployment by three rather than six months, which is more in line with anecdotal evidence regarding the time taken to fill a position once advertised, but (together with lagged changes in unemployment) still "explains around two-thirds of the growth in employment," ANZ said.
